title: setPauser(0) + emergencyTransfer permanently bricks ALL withdrawals (force-paused, no valid unpauser, pauseWithdraw escape drained, accounting never zeroed) - owner footgun
description: setPauser(0) is documented as 'disable pausing' (L204) and sounds benign (L206-208). A later emergency prompts emergencyTransfer: it sweeps all phUSD + reward (L218-223) and unconditionally _pause()s (L226). unpause() requires msg.sender == pauser (L197-198); with pauser==0 no account can ever unpause, so the contract is permanently paused. pauseWithdraw still passes whenPaused but its safeTransfer reverts (balance already drained), and user.amount/totalStaked were never zeroed -> the escape hatch is dead and accounting is permanently inconsistent.
impact: Operational hazard: the contract becomes permanently paused with non-zeroed accounting and a dead escape hatch. The funds themselves are removed by the (owner-trusted) emergencyTransfer drain, so the footgun's MARGINAL impact is the irreversible paused/locked state and inconsistent accounting, not additional asset loss beyond the trusted sweep.
attackPath: 1. Owner calls setPauser(0) - documented as 'disable pausing' (L204), sounds benign (L206-208).
2. A later emergency prompts emergencyTransfer: it sweeps all phUSD + reward (L218-223) and unconditionally _pause()s (L226).
3. unpause() requires msg.sender == pauser (L197-198); with pauser==0 no account can ever unpause -> permanent pause.

4. pauseWithdraw still passes whenPaused but its safeTransfer reverts (balance already drained), and user.amount/totalStaked were never zeroed -> escape hatch is dead and accounting is permanently inconsistent.
recommendation: Do not run with pauser==address(0) while emergencyTransfer is usable. In emergencyTransfer, either skip the unconditional auto-pause or zero user/total accounting on drain so the post-drain state is consistent; alternatively allow the owner to unpause when pauser==0.

tier3Verification.detail: Code-analysis, high confidence. Drain itself is an obvious owner power (KI-5 / DD-4) and is SUPPRESSED; kept only for the NON-OBVIOUS Law-3 footgun (permanent-pause + dead escape hatch + non-zeroed accounting).

footgunNote: Law-3 footgun, not malicious-admin: a competent non-malicious owner would be surprised that the documented 'disable pausing' (setPauser(0)) turns emergencyTransfer's auto-pause into an irreversible lock and silently leaves accounting non-zeroed. Capped at Centralization because the marginal harm is the permanent-pause state on already-(trustedly)-drained funds, not asset loss beyond the trusted drain.
borderlineFlag: Footgun, not malicious-admin. Would rise to High only if the footgun itself caused asset loss beyond the trusted drain - it does not.
